name: walk_fwd50_oab10_v1
description: Whole-body WALK on the floor with the scripted no-slip tripod gait (gait 1), measured by the overhead camera (chassis tag position and heading on the floor grid): mean speed, straight-line travel against the command, heading drift, tilt, total current. The loop stands the robot up itself, streams the gait command, stops, and sits it down. Forward 50 mm/s for 10 s, then the same back. Commanded one-way distance 500 mm.
